entries.48b4cae28296f10e: A SaaS-type platform that supports corporate activities by improving companies' engagement. Through three steps (visualizing the current state of the organization through engagement surveys, support from a dedicated customer success representative in planning and designing internal systems, and a cloud tool for operating internal systems), it provides one-stop support for improving engagement. As of the end of December 2025, the number of client companies was 1,344. No separate amounts are disclosed.
